title: Canonical finite open scalar comparison successor square
statement: For operations o, tensor comparison tc and scalar compatibility sc, form the canonical level isomorphism by whiskering tc.ordinary with scalar restriction and composing with sc.finite, then map it to cochain complexes. The resulting concrete level map commutes with the successor transitions of the unrestricted integral quotient complexes in every complex degree.

source.place: Tags 0E8I and 0941; quotient transition coherence on sheafified pure tensors

proof.text: Evaluate the two composites on sheafified pure tensors. The defining formula for unrestrictedIntegralTransition applies the coefficient quotient to the tensor scalar; tc.generators identifies the ordinary comparison on extension generators; and ScalarCompatibility.sections identifies finite extension with extension by zero on the same generator. Both paths therefore have the same section, and sheafification tensor generation and cochain extensionality give the equality.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarComparisonCanonicalTransition
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o)
    (n : ℕ) (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E X n).app
      ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj Q)).f i ≫
        (canonicalOpenQuotientScalarComparisonLevel l E j o tc sc n Q).hom.f i =
      (canonicalOpenQuotientScalarComparisonLevel l E j o tc sc (n + 1) Q).hom.f i ≫
        ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).map
          ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E U n).app Q)).f i
